description: Syntactic calque eval suite — EBE §2 examples. Each case is a (calque → correct form) pair extracted from Euskaltzaindia's EBE appendix. Tier classification (A-E) is the feasibility analysis from RESEARCH.md §7.17: A=feasible now (deterministic word/phrase swap), B=feasible with gazetteer/pattern, C=GECToR-covered (morphology, likely in R1-R4 training), D=needs POS/morphology (defer), E=context-dependent/multi-target (defer indefinitely).

tier_legend.A: Feasible now — deterministic word/phrase swap, low false-positive risk
tier_legend.B: Feasible with gazetteer — needs a finite word list, but pattern is deterministic
tier_legend.C: GECToR-covered — morphology error likely in Elhuyar R1-R4 training data
tier_legend.D: Needs POS/morphology — defer until src/core/tokenizer.js exists
tier_legend.E: Context-dependent/multi-target — needs semantic context or has 2+ valid forms

cases.note: Semantic: 'a wind' vs 'a huge wind'. Indefinite article calque, context-dependent.
Adjective position calque (pre-nominal → post-nominal). Specific calqued pairs via gazetteer. 'sozial arazo' has 2 targets (arazo sozial / gizarte-arazo).
Semantic: 'too much' vs 'much'. ?-marked in EBE, context-dependent.
Mass-noun detection needed: 'asko' for countables, 'handia' for mass. Needs morphology.
Semantic: 'new' (Spanish 'un nuevo') → 'beste' (another). Context-dependent.
Multi-target: 'the other day' → Joan zen egunean / lehengoan. Context-dependent.

cases.input: Bost urtez aritu zen Donostian irakasle bezala.
cases.expected: Bost urtez aritu zen Donostian irakasle.
cases.note: 'as a teacher' calque. ?-marked, 'bezala' sometimes valid. Context-dependent.
Semantic: 'different' for quantity (desberdin) vs quality. Restructuring.
Bare 'elkar' (no suffix) + verb is almost always wrong. Feasible as phrase pattern, but 2nd example has multi-target (elkarrekin/elkarri).

cases.input: Gure herria hain da txikia, ez duela plazarik ere.
cases.expected: Gure herria hain da txikia, non ez duen plazarik ere.
cases.note: 'so...that' clause calque. Needs syntax analysis.
Dialogue answer pattern. 'Inor' alone as negative answer → 'Inor ere ez'. Context-dependent.
Partitive calque: plural + 'Ez daude' → singular + -ik. Needs morphology (plural detection + suffix).
Verbal noun calque: infinitive → -tzen. Needs verb form analysis.

cases.input: Aspertu naiz hemen. Joaten gara etxera?
cases.expected: Aspertu naiz hemen. Joango gara etxera?
cases.note: False habitual aspect: present → future for immediate intent. GECToR R1 verb tense likely covers.
Modal 'poder' calque. Needs verb form + restructuring.
Conditional auxiliary agreement: luke→du. GECToR R2 aux agreement likely covers.
Reflexive→transitive aux: zara→duzu. GECToR R2 aux agreement likely covers.

cases.input: Hau bihar honela egin beharko zen.
cases.expected: Hau bihar honela egin beharko litzateke.
cases.note: Conditional 'would' calque: zen→litzateke. GECToR R1 verb form likely covers.
Collective noun agreement: dute→du (jendea is singular). GECToR R2 likely covers. Rule engine could do 'jendeak...dute' pattern but gap varies.
Historical present→past. GECToR R1 verb tense likely covers.
THE canonical example. State participle + naiz → nago. Needs gazetteer of egon-adjectives (nekatuta, beteta, lotsuta...). izan vs egon distinction.
Passive→active restructuring. Needs syntax + case analysis (ablative -gatuk → ergative -k).

cases.expected: Lagundu baino gehiago, kalte egiten du.
cases.note: 'rather than' calque. Pattern 'X baino, Y' → 'X baino gehiago, Y'. Needs contrastive context detection.

cases.input: Amaitzeko, bakarrik esan, hamabost egun daudela errekurtsoa aurkezteko.
cases.expected: Amaitzeko, bakarrik esan nahi dut, hamabost egun daudela errekurtsoa aurkezteko.
cases.note: Restructuring: 'to say' calque. 'esan' alone (Spanish 'decir') needs 'nahi dut'. Multi-target, restructuring.
'such as' calque. ?-marked, restructuring. Context-dependent.

cases.input: Langileen erdiak euskaldunak diren bitartean, beste erdiak, erdaldunak.
cases.expected: Langileen erdiak euskaldunak dira, eta beste erdiak, erdaldunak.
cases.note: 'whereas' calque. bitartean='during', not 'whereas'. Clause restructuring.
'already' calque. dagoeneko='already [completed]', honezkero='already [by now]'. Context-dependent (tense).

cases.input: Isabeli dagokionean, ez da etorri azterketara.
cases.expected: Isabeli dagokionez, ez da etorri azterketara.
cases.note: 'regarding' calque. dagokionean='when it corresponds' (temporal, valid), dagokionez='regarding' (adverbial). NOT a clean swap — dagokionean has valid temporal use. Context-dependent.
Spanish 'depende' calque. Restructuring, multi-target.
Percentage + article: '% 5a' → '% 5'. Deterministic pattern (% N + a → % N).

cases.expected: Mila eta bostehun euro balio ditu.
cases.note: Number conjunction: 'y' between numbers. BUT 'hiru bat' could mean 'about three' — ambiguous. Context-dependent.

cases.input: Kolpe bat eman zion, hilda utziz.
cases.expected: Kolpe bat eman zion, eta hil.
cases.note: Spanish gerund calque (-ndo → Basque). Needs verb form analysis + multiple forms (-ta/-z).
'also/too' position calque. 'ere' cannot start sentence. Needs reordering + ba- prefix. Syntax.

cases.input: Gure autoa, ez dela oso zaharra, askoz merkeagoa da.
cases.expected: Gure autoa, ez dena oso zaharra, askoz merkeagoa da.
cases.note: Relative clause calque: ez dela → ez dena. Needs verb form morphology.
Focus/topicalization. 'Ba' insertion. Context-dependent.
Plural→singular: gogoekin→gogoarekin. 'willing to' calque. Rare plural-use risk but mostly clean.
Adjective→adverb: hobe→hobeto before 'esan'. Phrase pattern 'hobe esan' → 'hobeto esan'.

cases.input: Bilera eta gero, kalera joan gara.
cases.note: 'after' calque: eta gero → ondoren. Multi-target, context-dependent. 'gero eta' → 'zenbat eta' is different.

cases.expected: Eta gero zer esan behar duzu?
cases.note: 'going to' (future intent) calque. ?-marked, restructuring.
Case calque: instrumental -z → inessive -n. Needs morphology + context.
Case calque: ablative -tik → inessive -n ('from' vs 'at'). Needs morphology + context.
Indirect question calque: -ren arabera / -az suffixes. Needs syntax.
Relative→indirect question: dena → zer den. Needs syntax analysis.
